test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 10 March, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Raj spends 10 percent of his money. He deposits 70 percent of the remaining money in the bank. If Rs. 2646 remains with him, how much money did he initially have?
solution:
**Calculation:**

Let Raj initially have Rs. 100x

Raj initially had Rs. 100x. After spending 10% of his money, he was left with 90x.

Out of this remaining amount, he spent 70%, which left him with 30% of the original 90x, which was equal to Rs. 2646.

30% of 90x = 2646

⇒ 27x = 2646

⇒ x = 98

So , 100x = 100 × 98 = 9800

**∴ Option 4 is the correct answer.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__

Let the sum of money be x

According to the question,

x × 9/10 × 3/10 = 2646

⇒ 27x/100 = 2646

⇒ x = 9800
